danvers.intro: CasperPortal is CRM software for Danvers, MA medical practices, auto dealers, HVAC companies, law firms and salons competing for customers along Route 1 and Route 128. It routes every new lead to the right person, follows up automatically by text and email, and tracks each opportunity so you know who still needs a reply.
danvers.localHook: Danvers sits where Route 1 meets Route 128, with a dense mix of retail, healthcare and automotive businesses. With competitors close by, the business that follows up first often wins.

useCases.h: Auto dealers assigning leads to salespeople
useCases.p: Workflows assign each new web or text lead to a salesperson, notify them, and start automatic follow-up so no shopper waits for a reply.

useCases.h: Medical practices filling cancellations
useCases.p: When an appointment opens up, text patients on your waitlist and let them book the slot from a link.

useCases.h: Law firms tracking intake
useCases.p: Track each potential client from first call to consultation to retained in a pipeline, with reminders for every follow-up step.

faqs: Can CasperPortal assign leads to different staff?
Yes. Workflows can assign new leads to a specific team member and notify them, and the Growth Plan includes unlimited users.
Can I track which marketing brings in calls?
Yes. Call tracking numbers show which source each call came from, and reporting shows leads by source.
Can I keep my business number?

Yes. You can port your existing business number into CasperPortal, or use a local tracking number that forwards to your phone. Either way, missed-call text-back and two-way texting work on that number.
What does it cost?
The Growth Plan is $297/month, month-to-month, with unlimited users and unlimited contacts. Danvers businesses pay the same as everyone else, and every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
